official: 文京区議会議員及び文京区長の選挙における選挙運動の公費負担に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年2月定例議会 議決結果

name: 選挙運動の公費負担額を引き上げる
summary: 現在、条例で定める公費負担額は、第6条・第8条が7円73銭、第11条が541円31銭です。この議案で、それぞれ8円38銭、586円88銭に改めます。公布の日から施行し、施行日以後に告示される区議会議員選挙・区長選挙に適用します。
changes: 第6条・第8条の公費負担額を7円73銭から8円38銭に引き上げる
第11条の公費負担額を541円31銭から586円88銭に引き上げる
who: 文京区議会議員選挙・文京区長選挙の候補者
why: 国会議員選挙の選挙運動にかかる公費負担額が引き上げられたことに伴い、区議会議員選挙と区長選挙の公費負担額も引き上げるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Raises public funding for election campaigns
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Public Expense Coverage for Election Campaigns in Elections for Bunkyo City Assembly Members and the Mayor of Bunkyo City
en.summary: The amounts of public funding currently set by the ordinance are ¥7.73 under Articles 6 and 8, and ¥541.31 under Article 11. This bill changes them to ¥8.38 and ¥586.88, respectively. It takes effect on the date of promulgation and applies to elections for Bunkyo City Assembly members and the mayor that are officially announced on or after the effective date.
changes: Raises the public funding amount under Articles 6 and 8 from ¥7.73 to ¥8.38
Raises the public funding amount under Article 11 from ¥541.31 to ¥586.88
who: Candidates in elections for Bunkyo City Assembly members and the mayor of Bunkyo City
en.why: The ward says it is raising the public funding amounts for elections for Bunkyo City Assembly members and the mayor because the public funding amounts for election campaigning in national Diet elections have been raised.
